name: Nem nướng
summary: Grilled pork rolls in Da Lat, eaten with rice paper that has been dried in the dew, herbs, and the house sauce.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note says Da Lat nem nướng is not the same plate as elsewhere, and names lean pork at one door.
howToEat: The note says the rolls come with bánh tráng phơi sương and fresh herbs, and that the sauce is mixed in the shop.
Bà Nghĩa also sells bánh xèo and chả giò. Those are separate plates. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: Nem nướng bà Hùng, 5 Trần Phú. Nem nướng bà Nghĩa, 45 Bùi Thị Xuân.
priceBand: Visit Lâm Đồng prints 45,000 VND a portion at bà Hùng and 45,000–70,000 VND at bà Nghĩa.
